subject: Claim Your Free iPhone Now!
body:
Dear valued customer,
Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a brand new iPhone absolutely free. To claim your prize, confirm your details at http://claim-prize.example.com within 24 hours.

body:

subject: Project Meeting Reminder
body:
Hi Team,
Just wanted to remind you about our project update meeting on Friday at 2pm. Please let me know if you can attend.

subject: Invoice Follow-up
